The '''Orbital Transports Union''' was a [[Union (workers)|union]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. After a set of new berthing taxes were implemented on Corulag, the union's members went on strike, which caused the world's economy to stall, and in an attempt to bring the protest to an end, the planetary leader [[Zafiel Snopps]] hired a gang of thugs to attack the union. Following a number of violent encounters with the gang, the union's leaders hired a group of agents to intervene and bring the protest to a peaceful resolution.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
